installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"
NEW_BINARY="${SERVER_DIR}/gate.new"
BINARY_URL="https://github.com/Isitseth/StrikeGate/raw/refs/heads/feature/multi-tenant-routes/dist/gate_linux_amd64"
CONFIG_URL="https://github.com/Isitseth/StrikeGate/raw/refs/heads/feature/multi-tenant-routes/config.yml"
EXPECTED_SHA256="81ea4f359c3e7f56385a1d7d74ecc8018ba824b5c2ed734905254022ee336d75"

failed() {
    code=$?
    rm -f "${NEW_BINARY}"
    echo "ERROR: StrikeGate download installation failed with exit code ${code}."
    exit "${code}"
}
trap failed ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl

echo "Downloading the prebuilt StrikeGate multi-tenant binary..."
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "${NEW_BINARY}" "${BINARY_URL}"
echo "${EXPECTED_SHA256}  ${NEW_BINARY}" | sha256sum --check --status
chmod 0755 "${NEW_BINARY}"
mv -f "${NEW_BINARY}" "${SERVER_DIR}/gate"

if [ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/config.yml" ]; then
    curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "${SERVER_DIR}/config.yml" "${CONFIG_URL}"
    echo "Installed the branch configuration template."
else
    echo "Preserved existing config.yml."
fi

trap - ERR
echo "StrikeGate installed successfully."
ls -lh "${SERVER_DIR}/gate"
